intent: To demonstrate that Ikea's legal structure effectively makes it one of the world's largest charitable foundations.

units.meaning: Stichting Ingka (Ikea's foundation) is third largest among the four entities shown: Bill & Melinda Gates 51.6 > Novo Nordisk 49.1 > Stichting Ingka 36.0 > Wellcome Trust 32.9.
accepted_routes: Stichting Ingka ranks third, behind the Gates Foundation and Novo Nordisk and ahead of Wellcome Trust.
The chart order is Gates 51.6, Novo Nordisk 49.1, Stichting Ingka 36.0, Wellcome Trust 32.9.
Ikea is the third-largest foundation in this comparison.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Bars or labels must show Stichting Ingka in third position, with two larger values above it and one smaller value below it.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video state/show Ikea as third in the ranking, or is it enough to show Ikea as merely one of the largest?

units.meaning: Stichting Ingka's charted value is 36.000, with relative_value 0.6000.
accepted_routes: Stichting Ingka (Ikea) has a value of 36.0 and relative value 0.6000.
Ikea's foundation endpoint is 36.0 on the chart.
The Stichting Ingka bar ends at 36.0, or 0.60 on the relative scale.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Stichting Ingka's bar/endpoint must be labeled 36.0 or 0.6000 relative.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause introducing Ikea/Stichting Ingka as the third-largest charity
units.reviewer_question: Must the animation show Ikea's own value/endpoint, or can it omit it and only show rank/gap?

units.meaning: Ikea/Stichting Ingka is about 30% smaller than the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

basis.note: Gates value used as comparison denominator
Gates relative value for alternate formula
Ikea relative value for alternate formula

accepted_routes: Ikea is about 30% smaller than the Gates Foundation.
Ikea/Stichting Ingka is about 70% of the Gates Foundation's value (36.0 vs 51.6).
The Gates-to-Ikea gap is 15.6, equal to about 30.2% of Gates's 51.6.
Using relative values, 0.6000 is about 30.2% below 0.8600.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The visual must compare Gates and Ikea and show or label the roughly 30% smaller gap, not just their absolute bars.
units.temporal_anchor: the 'only 30 % smaller than the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation' clause
units.reviewer_question: Must the video quantify Ikea as roughly 30% smaller than Gates, or is a visual gap enough?

units.meaning: Novo Nordisk is above Stichting Ingka at 49.1, which is why Ikea is third rather than second.
accepted_routes: Ikea is behind both Gates and Novo Nordisk, with Novo at 49.1.
The second-place Novo Nordisk bar is 13.1 points above Ikea's 36.0.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Novo Nordisk's bar must be visibly taller than Stichting Ingka's, establishing Ikea as third.
units.temporal_anchor: the ranking clause, before or when saying third largest
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly show Novo Nordisk above Ikea, or is a generic third-place label enough?

units.meaning: Wellcome Trust is below Stichting Ingka at 32.9, so Ikea is not the smallest.
accepted_routes: Stichting Ingka (36.0) is above Wellcome Trust (32.9).
Wellcome Trust is the smallest at 32.9, below Ikea's 36.0.
Ikea's value is 3.1 higher than Wellcome's.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Wellcome Trust's bar must be shorter than Stichting Ingka's.
units.temporal_anchor: optional in the ranking clause or bar labels
units.reviewer_question: Is it necessary to show Ikea is above Wellcome, or is that extra context?

optional_valid: Show all four entity names and absolute values as bar labels: Gates 51.6, Novo Nordisk 49.1, Stichting Ingka 36.0, Wellcome Trust 32.9.
Display the relative_value scores 0.8600, 0.8183, 0.6000, and 0.5483 alongside the bars.
Animate the 15.6 gap between Gates and Stichting Ingka.
Highlight Wellcome Trust as the smallest bar at 32.9.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claim that Ikea's legal structure directly causes its foundation value or rank.
Claim that Ikea is the world's largest or second-largest charity; the table only ranks it third among the four shown.
Claim that Ikea/Stichting Ingka is larger than Novo Nordisk or the Gates Foundation.
Treat relative_value 0.6000 as a 60% share of the four-fund total; the table's relative_value denominator is not given.
Extrapolate from these four entities to all charitable foundations worldwide.
State that Gates is about 30% larger than Ikea; the correct derived statement is that Ikea is about 30% smaller than Gates.
notes: Core contested decisions: whether the ~30% smaller-than-Gates gap is obligatory, and whether Novo Nordisk's second-place bar must be shown to justify Ikea's third rank. The table supports only these four entities; avoid treating relative_value as a share unless the denominator is specified.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
